legacy_failure_addressed: legacy bot exposed no single-call composition surface that pinned the abstain/proceed threshold and the decision clock at construction time, so consumers reaching into the orchestrator could pass divergent thresholds or wall-clock helpers and silently produce inconsistent abstain reason codes. The 2F.C binder fixes this by capturing both knobs at build time, validating them once, and forwarding only a TrainerPredictionRecord at call time so the default-deny taxonomy in 2F.B remains the single source of truth.

The single-call evaluator captures the low_confidence_threshold and now_ms_clock at build time and is the consumable surface for REQ_0017 milestone 3 RISK_GATEWAY_DEFAULT_DENY_MVP. It is the final binder layer of the orchestrator decision derivation surface introduced by 2F.A and 2F.B.
